brief: Small wood-framed garage 12 ft by 18 ft in board-and-batten siding painted barn red and weathered to grey in streaks, on a low concrete sill, under a newer gable roof of dark green ribbed metal. Double plank doors on long strap hinges fill the north gable end; a small window with a board shelf and a narrow door are on the east side. Bare oaks and elms lean over it, and weathered grey granaries and the barn stand close by. (Small garage; nearest vocabulary type is frame_machine_shed.)
